note.body:
Hi Kenji,

We're excited that Yuki Tanaka will be joining the APAC Sales team as an Account Executive. She starts in 28 days on 2026-07-12.

We've scheduled an intro meeting for July 13th at 09:00 AM to get things rolling.

For an onboarding buddy, I'd suggest Mei Lin. With 2.5 years of experience in Singapore's enterprise sales market, she could be a great fit to guide Yuki.

You'll find a draft 30-60-90 day plan below. This is a starting point for you to review and tailor as you see fit before sharing it with Yuki.

Additionally, a manager prep checklist is provided to assist you.

Best regards,

The Onboarding team

thirty_days: Understand APAC sales strategies by attending briefing sessions with key team members and reviewing current sales data using Salesforce.
Complete training on Outreach.io and Gong to ensure effective use of tools.
Establish relationships with at least 5 key stakeholders through introductory meetings.
sixty_days: Lead a small sales initiative targeting the Singaporean market and report results to the team.
Deliver at least 2 new client accounts through nurtured leads, using Gong insights and Outreach.io campaigns.
Collaborate with Mei Lin to understand enterprise sales processes specific to the region.
ninety_days: Take full ownership of client accounts in Singapore, managing the sales pipeline independently in Salesforce.
Develop a strategic sales plan for the next quarter and present it to the team.
Establish a viewpoint on regional sales tactics and propose a strategy to increase market share.

manager_checklist: Review the 30-60-90 day plan for Yuki Tanaka and adjust according to team strategy.
Ensure Yuki has access to all necessary systems: Salesforce, Gong, Outreach.io, and Slack.
Prepare to introduce Yuki to key team members and stakeholders in APAC region.
Set expectations for first week's goals and support Yuki in understanding role expectations.
Familiarize yourself with Yuki's previous experience and potential fit within the team.

details.body:
Hi Yuki,

Welcome to our APAC Sales team! We’re thrilled to have you join us as an Account Executive here in sunny Singapore.

On your first day, your Dell XPS 13 will be all set up and ready to help you dive into your exciting role. You’ll also have access to crucial tools like Salesforce, Gong, and Outreach.io. Plus, don’t worry about navigating everything on your own—Mei Lin, your onboarding buddy, will be reaching out to guide you through the ropes.

We’ve scheduled an introductory meeting with your manager, Kenji Watanabe, for the morning of July 13th. It'll be a great opportunity to discuss your initial goals and get to know the team better.

We’re all excited to work with you and look forward to seeing the great things you’ll achieve!

Best,  
Kenji Watanabe

For an onboarding buddy, I'd suggest Mei Lin. With 2.5 years of experience in Singapore's enterprise sales market, she could be a great fit to guide Yuki.

You'll find a draft 30-60-90 day plan below. This is a starting point for you to review and tailor as you see fit before sharing it with Yuki.

Additionally, a manager prep checklist is provided to assist you.

Best regards,

The Onboarding team

thirty_days: Understand APAC sales strategies by attending briefing sessions with key team members and reviewing current sales data using Salesforce.
Complete training on Outreach.io and Gong to ensure effective use of tools.
Establish relationships with at least 5 key stakeholders through introductory meetings.
sixty_days: Lead a small sales initiative targeting the Singaporean market and report results to the team.
Deliver at least 2 new client accounts through nurtured leads, using Gong insights and Outreach.io campaigns.
Collaborate with Mei Lin to understand enterprise sales processes specific to the region.
ninety_days: Take full ownership of client accounts in Singapore, managing the sales pipeline independently in Salesforce.
Develop a strategic sales plan for the next quarter and present it to the team.
Establish a viewpoint on regional sales tactics and propose a strategy to increase market share.

manager_checklist: Review the 30-60-90 day plan for Yuki Tanaka and adjust according to team strategy.
Ensure Yuki has access to all necessary systems: Salesforce, Gong, Outreach.io, and Slack.
Prepare to introduce Yuki to key team members and stakeholders in APAC region.
Set expectations for first week's goals and support Yuki in understanding role expectations.
Familiarize yourself with Yuki's previous experience and potential fit within the team.

details.body:
Hi Yuki,

Welcome to our APAC Sales team! We’re thrilled to have you join us as an Account Executive here in sunny Singapore.

On your first day, your Dell XPS 13 will be all set up and ready to help you dive into your exciting role. You’ll also have access to crucial tools like Salesforce, Gong, and Outreach.io. Plus, don’t worry about navigating everything on your own—Mei Lin, your onboarding buddy, will be reaching out to guide you through the ropes.

We’ve scheduled an introductory meeting with your manager, Kenji Watanabe, for the morning of July 13th. It'll be a great opportunity to discuss your initial goals and get to know the team better.

We’re all excited to work with you and look forward to seeing the great things you’ll achieve!

Best,  
Kenji Watanabe
